name: Waterworks bank beside the Artificial Manure Works
method: Interpolate the three distinct surveyed bank-surface dots along northing in the dry compartment south of Potters Ditch and west of the Artificial Manure Works. Confine the correction to a 6m bank strip. Keep it separate from the lower margin across the connecting watercourse. Blend into provisional landward ground and at review ends.
limitations: Hatching and spot heights establish a raised bank surface here, but the dots do not measure a continuous maximum flood-defence crest.
The two 18.0ft inventory entries describe one dot; only the canonical bank entry is applied.
The 15.1ft Potter’s Ditch observation lies across water and is not used in this bank fit.
Water-edge and landward slopes remain interpreted; factory yards and buildings are outside this narrow correction.
Datum conversion, water and riverbed heights remain provisional. This patch is not applied to the flood solver.
